transcript.text: I reviewed the signed artist license this morning and found three key constraints: Signal Garden may be presented only as ticketed sessions, the festival may not record it, and all visitor materials must use the credit wording 'Signal Garden by Nia Okafor'. This conflicts with the draft plan's walk-up admission and festival recording for promotional use.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I completed an on-site accessibility assessment this week and found three key constraints: Signal Garden can accommodate at most 40 people per session, requires exactly four daily sessions rather than the six in the draft plan, and requires a 15-minute room reset between sessions for mobility equipment and sensory-access preparation.
transcript.speaker: A3

commitments.detail: Schedule exactly four daily ticketed sessions with a 15-minute room reset between each session for mobility equipment and sensory-access preparation.
Use the credit wording 'Signal Garden by Nia Okafor' in all visitor materials and promotional references.
No festival recording of Signal Garden sessions; remove any plans for promotional recording.
Implement ticketed admission with a maximum capacity of 40 people per session, replacing the walk-up admission model.
